mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (userId, targetType, targetId, targetName, targetImg, createTime) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{targetImg}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE userId = #{userId} AND targetType = #{targetType} AND targetId = #{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, userId, targetType, targetId, targetName, targetImg, createTime FROM favorite WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
